title: Ashfall Showcase Opening
summary: Touch Terminal, Index, Lens, HoloMap, MissionCore, WeatherCore, RelicTech, PowerGrid, Armory, and story hooks in one clear first-session path.
body: Use this only in the Ashfall official profile. Generic templates should keep their own starter loops and should not inherit Ashfall story names or required modules.
steps: Open Terminal and read the dashboard.
Read the Showcase Flow Index entry.
Accept the Ashfall Showcase Opening mission.
Respond to the first WeatherCore warning.
commonMistakes: Copying Ashfall text into generic templates.
Making echoashfallprotocol a reusable module dependency.
